To whom it may concern at Demo Bank,

I am writing to you, with all due respect, because I do not understand why my account has been blocked since last week. I am a retired teacher, 67 years old, and I never had any problem with the bank before. I did not know the money came from a scam, I thought it was normal online job. Now I am left without access to my own money and I am very worried, please help me understand what happened and how I can fix this.

With respect,
Elena
